aarti.tek: Victory to Mother Vaiṣṇavī; Mother, victory to Mother Vaiṣṇavī. With joined hands before you I sing the āratī.
aarti.pad1: A canopy graces your head, and your image is lovely. The Gaṅgā flows at your feet, and a wondrous flame burns. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Brahmā reads the Vedas daily at your door, and Śiva meditates; a servant waves the fly-whisk, and Nārada dances. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Your cave is beautiful and greatly delights the heart. O Mother, the heart longs to see it again and again. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Flags sway over your shrine, and the sound of bells rings out. Your high mountain, Mother, seems dear. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: With betel leaf, areca nut, a flag, a coconut, flowers and dried fruits as offerings, your servants stand at your feet: grant us your darśana, O Goddess. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever comes to your door with a firm resolve, Mother, has his wish fulfilled. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings all this praise day and night, says the servant Dhyānū, gains happiness and wealth. ॥7॥
